question: Who among the following authors won the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar 2021 for the collection of short stories 'Kissa Kissa Lucknowa-Lucknow Ke Awami Kisse'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Himanshu Vajpai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sahitya Akademi declares Winners of Yuva Puraskar, **Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2021.**
 
• **Megha Majumdar **won the Yuva Puraskar for her introduction novel 'A Consuming' and Himanshu Vajpai won it for his assortment of brief tales named** 'Kissa Lucknow - Lucknow Ke Awami Kisse.**
 
• Sahitya Akademi Grants 2021 have been reported on **December 30, 2021.**
 
• Young writer Dadapeer Jyman and novelist Tammanna Bergara have been awarded the Kendra Sahitya Akademi award for **2022.**
